overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the formula text associated with the list box column (empty string if none), addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag). Only meaningful for Current Selection/Named Selection/Collection or Entity Selection data sources.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the formula text associated with the list box column (empty string if none), addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*'). Only meaningful for Current Selection/Named Selection/Collection or Entity Selection data sources.

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').
